summary: Float pass-through shim used by quaternion and rotation math. Receives a double value, runs FloatExponentExtractWithNaNGuard on it (NaN/exponent guard), then forwards the float state to sub_5894BD and returns that result. The rendered source shows the two locals v2/v3 being passed uninitialized, which is treated as a decompiler artifact of the pass-through rather than real data flow.

local_names.a1: double value carried through the pass-through shim
local_names.v2: local rendered as forwarded argument; value flow not visible in decompiled source
local_names.v3: local rendered as forwarded argument; value flow not visible in decompiled source

operations.description: Call FloatExponentExtractWithNaNGuard(a1, HIDWORD(a1)) to run the NaN/exponent guard on the incoming double before forwarding.
Forward the float state to sub_5894BD(v2, v3).
Return the result of sub_5894BD(v2, v3).

Used as a float-component pass-through by quaternion and rotation math: QuaternionNormalizeAndDecompose (0x0050DAB2), RotationVectorToQuaternion (0x0050E055), QuaternionSphericalInterpolation (0x0053B5B0), CrossProductNormalize (0x0056C540), plus sub_426100, sub_4FAF60, sub_567580.
